How to get a list of recent channel bumps to test vibenix:

Install npc:

```
mschwaig@mutalisk ~ [128]> nix shell github:samestep/npc
```

Run  `npc fetch` and then `npc log` for the `nixpkgs-unstable` channel:

```
mschwaig@mutalisk ~> npc log nixpkgs-unstable -n 20
6f374686605df381de8541c072038472a5ea2e2d 2025-11-18 12:19:29 +0100
0ade817efdde79cbc46b624c849027335ebc25c5 2025-11-18 04:14:24 +0100

85a6c4a07faa12aaccd81b36ba9bfc2bec974fa1 2025-11-16 18:00:02 +0100
```

If this gives us too many channel bumps, we can try using `nixos-unstable` instead,
which only advances when certain vm tests pass, so that (some?) nixos modules have test coverage.
